summary: Ninja Theory and Sony's Heavenly Sword is a PlayStation 3 exclusive action game whose archive route centers on PS3 hardware, with emulator capture only as a labeled comparison.

entries.title: Heavenly Sword

emulation.notes: Use a legally dumped copy and record emulator build/settings if used.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS3 hardware for official behavior; RPCS3 for labeled high-resolution comparison

primary.why: Heavenly Sword is a PS3-exclusive action game with Sixaxis-era input and PS3 presentation context. Original hardware preserves the intended console behavior, while RPCS3 can be useful for high-resolution comparison but is not the official route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original PS3 copy on PS3 hardware. Record region/media, system firmware, display output, controller/Sixaxis setup, difficulty, chapter, subtitles/audio, installed game data, and whether RPCS3 was used for comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: High-resolution emulator capture and compatibility testing
secondary.what_to_play: Use only with a legally dumped copy for comparison or accessibility.
secondary.why: It can improve capture flexibility but differs from original PS3 hardware behavior.

all_releases.reason: primary: official and historically accurate platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Emulated PS3 route with compatibility caveats and potential high-resolution capture.
all_releases.reason: secondary: useful comparison/capture route when legally dumped.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original PS3 hardware is authoritative; emulator capture can improve resolution but must be labeled.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC, PS4, PS5, or remaster route replaces the PS3 version. RPCS3 is a comparison route, not an official release.
